ios.desc:
Tripbook is a mileage tracker app built to save you time and ensure complete, accurate trip logs. Whether you're a freelancer, employee, or anyone who needs reliable mileage records for tax deductions or expense reporting, Tripbook makes vehicle tracking effortless and dependable.

Powered by industry-leading trip detection technology, Tripbook automatically recognizes when you're driving and logs your journey, no manual input required. This ensures accurate, complete records without the hassle of traditional mileage tracking.

Why Tripbook?
◉ SAVE TIME - Automatically track trips, no manual logging needed.
◉ COMPLETE RECORD - Never miss a journey thanks to accurate, automatic logging.
◉ INSTANT TAX REPORTING - Generate ready-to-use mileage reports in seconds.
◉ DATA STAYS WITH YOU - Your mileage logs are backed up to your personal iCloud, not shared or stored elsewhere. 
◉ CONSISTENTLY ACCURATE - You get dependable, precise mileage tracking. Every trip, every time.

Key Features
◉ AUTOMATIC TRIP DETECTION - Trips are logged automatically as soon as you start driving, no manual input required.
◉ CLASSIFY TRIPS - Easily tag each trip as business, personal, or commuting with a simple swipe.
◉ FOREVER FREE PLAN - Always free. Track up to 20 trips per month, no trial, no expiration.
◉ DETAILED REPORTS - Export your trip data as XLS, CSV, or PDF files, perfect for taxes, reimbursements, or business records.
◉ ICLOUD BACK-UP - Your data stays yours, Tripbook never stores or accesses your trip information.
◉ CUSTOM ALLOWANCES - Set your own mileage rates for business and commuting trips.
◉ VEHICLE & ODOMETER TRACKING - Add your vehicles and log odometer readings to include accurate mileage data in your reports.

Download Tripbook today for accurate and effortless trip tracking. For support or feedback, contact us at info@tripbook.io.

quotes.text:
I am excited to announce the launch of Tripbook, a mileage tracker app that I have developed

As a freelancer, I personally experienced the lack of quality mileage tracking apps that where user-friendly, accurate mileage tracking and not too expensive.

The core objective in developing Tripbook was to create an app that is exceptionally user-friendly. I aimed to provide an intuitive and seamless experience for tracking and managing car trips.

Tripbook automatically detect yours trips, records them, and allows you to easily categorize them as business, personal or commute. Furthermore, can you generate reports in CSV, XLS or PDF.

If you are interested and trying out Tripbook, you can download the app from the App Store (free till 20 trips a months) using this link https://apps.apple.com/app/id6447760823

Looking forward for any feedback or comments!
